plan.objective: Restore gradient at the face/body junction with E14's protected reconstruction loss.
plan.hypothesis: masked_loss_step=1 leaves the neck/jaw/shoulder junction unsupervised at every step. On large_dataset that is harmless because the reference arrives at ratio 1.00, so the in-mask optimum is body-consistent; on cosmic the branch is fed a ~2.2x oversized face and the in-mask optimum cannot meet the shoulders. A boundary ring should fix alignment.
plan.single_scientific_change: loss_kind=branched_reference with face 1.0 / full 0.1 / boundary-ring 0.05 (width 2); everything else identical to CL3
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240 tensors / 219,217,920 params, ROI warp ON, native 256px reference, mirroring off, pose-first captions capped at 50
plan.primary_metric: face/body ALIGNMENT: images outside E13's centre-offset envelope (p90=0.095), measured by tools/datasets/measure_face_body_alignment.py at MATCHED steps. id_sim is explicitly secondary this round.

decision_gates.telemetry: first 3 batches log the new loss component non-zero (loss_boundary / loss_full)
decision_gates.step_0: panel identical to CL3 (id_sim .32788); neither arm changes the inference route
decision_gates.step_4000: images outside E13 envelope below CL3's 32; id_sim within 0.02 of CL3's .34294
decision_gates.promotion: alignment approaching E13's 9/96 with id_sim at or above CL3
